Ashland Breakfast Club (ABC) Ride

Glen Allen, VA · Road

Ashland Breakfast Club (ABC) Ride is a road group ride in Glen Allen, VA. It rolls every Saturday at 9:00 am from Rear lot behind the football field at RF&P Park, Crump Park.

How we know

RABA's weekly rides page, titled Weekly Rides for October 2026, lists the Ashland Breakfast Club Ride on Saturdays at 9 am from RF&P Park, with leaders named for Oct 3 and later (page fetched Oct 1, 2026).

For visitors

Non-members should contact the weekly ride leader by Friday afternoon to confirm the start time. The leader picks 8:30 or 9:00 depending on the weather.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: all paces; riders may self-group. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Ashland Breakfast Club (ABC) Ride group ride

A 20 to 40+ mile, mostly flat ride from the back lot at RF&P Park in Crump Park, with most routes heading to Ashland for a rest stop. All paces are welcome; riders may follow the posted route or group up in the lot. It is not a no-drop ride, but the leaders usually try to regroup.
